hook_text: 3 1/3 m by 2 1/4 m. The area is NOT 6 1/12. Watch.
clip_script: To multiply mixed numbers, first convert them to improper fractions. Three and one third is ten thirds. Two and a quarter is nine quarters. Ten thirds times nine quarters. Cancel: ten and four share two, nine and three share three. Five times three over one times two: fifteen halves, which is seven and a half square metres.
visual_style: A garden plot grid with edge strips highlighted that the wrong shortcut misses; numbers shrink as they cancel; 15/2 becomes 7 1/2.
pacing: Wrong answer flash, then convert, cancel and multiply in three beats.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to see why a part of a part is always smaller.
